_comment: Phase-1 benchmark aircraft. Narrow-body airliner. APPROXIMATE. JSBSim '737' is a generic 737 (variant not stated in the file; BETA) with its own yaw damper in the FCS.
name: b737

sources.geometry_inertia: JSBSim 1.3.1 stock model aircraft/737/737.xml (metrics, mass_balance) -- an approximate public model (release=BETA)
sources.mass_lb: JSBSim 737 inertia/weight-lbs as loaded (empty 83,000 lb + fuel/payload) = 107,000 lb
sources.control_derivatives: 737.xml: Cmde table -1.20 (M0) .. -0.30 (M2) and Clda 0.100 .. 0.033, linearly interpolated at the benchmark Mach ~0.45 -> ~-1.0 and ~0.085 (approx); Cndr = -0.20 per rad
sources.control_limits: 737.xml FCS: elevator +/-0.3 rad (17.2 deg), aileron +/-0.35 rad (20 deg), rudder +/-0.35 rad (20 deg)
sources.speeds_n: approx public 737 Classic/NG figures: VMO ~340 KIAS, MMO ~0.82, FAR-25 +2.5/-1.0 g; clean stall ~140 KCAS is ROUGH (weight dependent); cruise ~430 KTAS rough
sources.design_point: phase-1 benchmark condition (250 KCAS, 10,000 ft, ~M0.45: the below-FL100 speed limit), not a cruise point
sources.pitch_cmd_limits_deg: design choice (passenger aircraft), not aircraft data
sources.sim_envelope: min_kcas 195: team decision 2026-10-06 -- the JSBSim 737 built-in trim fails below ~190 KCAS at 10,000 ft (FD INTERFACE.md 4d #4), although the public clean stall is ~140 KCAS; FAR-25 n limits
sources.flex_constants: Flight Dynamics final Phase-1 values (INTERFACE.md section 0, 2026-10-06 04:05 PT; flexwing.AIRCRAFT_PROFILES): fixed, not genes; section CG aft of the elastic axis (>= 0.02 chord); tip mass 0. Notional (typical ranges, not manufacturer data). Never passed to FD (FD applies its own copy); kept here for reporting and checked equal to FD's in tests.

_shared: Trim point, envelope (min_kcas, nz), pitch-command clamp, throttle_max and pitch/altitude gain bounds come from phase1_shared.json (see ALIGNMENT.md); the sources below still document them.
